questions.question: The __________ Commission was set up to investigate the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1 i.e__** Hunter**__

**Jallianwala Bagh massacre:**

 
• **On 13th April,** a large crowd of people from neighbouring villages, unaware of the prohibitory orders in the** Amritsar** gathered in the **Jallianwala Bagh.**
 
• **Brigadier-General Dyer** arrived on the scene with his men and he gave the orders to his men to fire on the unarmed crowd killing more than 1000 unarmed men, women, and children.
 
• The government formed a committee of inquiry to investigate the Jallianwala Bagh shooting named **Disorders Inquiry Committee**.which is known as **Hunter Commission** after the** name of chairman, Lord William Hunter.**
 
• The Committee submitted its report in **1920** but they did not impose any penalty or disciplinary action against General Dyer.

questions.question: The firing order issued by _______ on a gathering of people on Baisakhi Day, 1919 became a turning point in India’s freedom struggle.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The Jallianwala Bagh massacre, also known as the Amritsar massacre, took place on April 13, 1919.
 
• On this day, around 50 troops of the British Indian Army, under the command of **Colonel Reginald Dyer,**__ fired on a crowd of Baishakhi pilgrims, who had gathered in Jallianwala Bagh, Amritsar, Punjab.
 
• __**Hunter commission**__ was formed to look into this incident.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi returned his Kaiser-e-Hind in response to the Jallianwala Bagh Massacre which was given to him by the British government for his services during the Boer War in South Africa.
 
• Rabindranath Tagore returned his Knighthood in response to the massacre.
 
• __**Lord Chelmsford **__(1916-1921) was the Viceroy of India during the Jallianwala Bagh Massacre.

questions.question: Asian Premium is the high price that Asian countries pay to import ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Asian premium is the effective high price that Asian countries such as India and China pay to import **crude from Oil Producing and Exporting Countries (OPEC) **__such as Saudi Arabia and Iran.
 
• 
 
The mission of the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) is to coordinate and unify the petroleum policies of its Member Countries and ensure the stabilization of oil markets in order to secure an efficient, economic and regular supply of petroleum to consumers, a steady income to producers and a fair return on capital for those investing in the petroleum industry.

 
 
• 
 
OPEC is an intergovernmental organization. Qatar has recently left the OPEC(2019)

 
 
• 
 
OPEC doesn't levy the charge on the richer Western nations because Saudi Arabia adopted a market-based price system and there was no strong crude derivatives market in Asia.

 
 
• 
 
Venezuela has the largest crude oil reserves.

 
 
• OPEC: Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries.
 
 
• It is an intergovernmental organization of **14 nations.**
 
• Headquarters: **Vienna, Austria.**

questions.question: Right ________ ceased to be a fundamental right after the 45th Amendment bill, 1978 to the Indian Constitution.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **The 45th constitutional amendment bill was renamed as the 44 amendment Act.**__
 
• __**In the original constitution, the right to property was a fundamental right under article 31.**__
 
• Right to property was removed from the list of the Fundamental Rights by the __**44th Constitution Amendment Act, 1978**__ and after amendment, it was made legal right under Article 300-A in part-12 of the Constitution.
 
• The Constitution of India guarantees 6 fundamental rights to its citizens.

 
 

 Fundamental Right
 Article Number
 
 

 Right to equality
 14-18
 
 

 Right to freedom
 19-22
 
 

 Right against exploitation
 23-24
 
 

 Right to freedom of religion
 25-28
 
 

 Cultural and Educational rights
 29-30
 
 

 Right to constitutional remedies
 32-35
 
 

 
 

 __**Amendment Act**__
 __**Changes made**__
 
 

 41st amendment act
 Chairman and members of the State Public Service Commissions retiring age changed from 60 to 62 years(article 316).
 
 

 42nd amendment act
 "Socialist" and "Integrity" added to Preamble, new directive principles of state policy added(Article 39A,43A,48A).
 
 

 
 
44th amendment act

 
 Right to property, not a fundamental right. It has been shifted from Article 31 to 300A.
 
 

 61th amendment act
 Changed eligible voters age from 21 to 18 years.
 
 

 69 amendment act
 Delhi was made the National Capital territory. It was awarded partial statehood and provided for a legislative assembly.
 
 

 86th amendment act
 The right to education was made a fundamental right(Article 21A).
 
 

 101 amendment act
 Introduction of Goods and service tax.

 
 
 

 103 amendment act
 Economically weaker section 10% reservation.

questions.question: _______ is an ancient Sanskrit text on medicine and surgery.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The **Sushruta Samhita **is an ancient **Sanskrit text on medicine and surgery**.
 
• The **Compendium of Suśruta **is considered as **one of the basic texts of Ayurveda**.
 
• It also considered as one of the **two basic Hindu texts **on **medical domain **survived from ancient civilization in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Arthashastra

 
 
• The Arthashastra is one of the earliest works of political realism to have been written, along with Sun Tzu's The Art of War and Machiavelli's The Prince.
 
• Kautilya Arthashastra is a unique treatise on the art of statecraft or governance, wherein every single aspect of human life is subject to the jurisdiction of the state.
 
• His detailed work clearly laid down an organizational set-up, and there was a clear-cut division of ethics and politics. 
 
• The 'Arthashastra' is a treasure of Political Philosophy. 
 
 
 
• Raghuvamsha 
 
 
• ​It is one of the great court epic poems (mahakavyas) written in Sanskrit by Kalidasa about the 5th century CE.
 
• It consists of 19 cantos composed of some 1,570 verses.
 
• It describes the line of kings of the Raghu dynasty.
 
• The Raghuvamsha is famous for its beautiful descriptions and incidental narratives, which give the poem a somewhat episodic character.
 
 
 
• **Abhijnanashakuntala**
 
 
• It was written by Kalidasa.
 
• It is a drama based on the story of Shakuntala from Mahabharata. 
 
• Shakuntala was the daughter of the sage Vishwamitra.
 
• Its Bengali translation was written by Ishwar Chandra Vidyasagar and Abanindranath Tagore.
